sub.en: Polite informal (해요체), formal polite (합쇼체), and intimate casual (반말)
sub.ko: 상황에 따른 세 가지 말투 비교, 어미 변화 규칙과 전환 연습

desc.en: Free printable Korean worksheet on speech levels: 해요체 (polite informal), 합쇼체 (formal polite), and 반말 (intimate casual) — sentence endings, conversion rules with practice exercises and an answer key.

rows: Daily conversations with coworkers, acquaintances, elders
Presentations, news broadcasts, business, formal service
Close friends of same age, younger siblings, children
sections.note: Foreign learners should primarily use 해요체. Switching to casual 반말 requires mutual agreement or same-age close friendship.
Quick conversion rule: remove the polite ending marker 요 from 해요체 to make casual 반말 (가요 → 가, 먹어요 → 먹어, 좋아요 → 좋아).

sections.text: In polite speech (해요체 and 합쇼체), use humble pronouns for yourself: 저 (I) and 저희 (we). In casual speech (반말), switch to informal pronouns: 나 (I), 우리 (we), and 너 (you). Never call an adult or elder 너.

title.en: Practice A — Convert base form to polite informal (해요체)
Practice B — Convert base form to formal polite (합쇼체 -ㅂ/습니다)
Practice C — Convert polite 해요체 into casual 반말
Practice D — Choose the appropriate speech level in context

items.q: To a stranger: 저기요, 길 좀 ___ (알려줘 / 알려주세요) →
In a formal news report: 오늘 비가 ___ (옵니다 / 와) →
To your best same-age friend: 주말에 뭐 ___ ? (해 / 하세요) →
Humble pronoun for 'I' in polite speech: ___ 는 학생이에요 (저 / 나) →
Casual pronoun to friend: ___ 도 같이 갈래? (너 / 당신) →

howto: Learn the distinctive endings of the 3 speech levels: -아/어요 (해요체), -ㅂ/습니다 (합쇼체), and -아/어 (반말).
Notice how dropping the final 요 from 해요체 produces natural casual 반말.
Solve Practice A to D and check your answers with the answer key.
koSummary: 한국어의 대표적인 세 가지 말투(해요체, 합쇼체, 반말)의 용도와 어미 규칙, 그리고 인칭 대명사(저/나)의 알맞은 사용법을 한 장에 정리했습니다. 문장 전환 연습을 풀고 정답지로 확인하세요.
